name: Deep Secrets lengthens Librams and Testaments (#2593)
contract: Deep Secrets 705263 is a +10000 ms flat SPELLMOD_DURATION passive on the Libram and Testament family mask. Libram of Tenacity (801461) lasts 20000 ms and Testament of Fortitude (500678) 15000 ms, so the talented Templar gets 30000 ms and 25000 ms.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Untalented Libram of Tenacity lasts 20 sec
Deep Secrets adds 10 sec to Libram of Tenacity
Deep Secrets adds 10 sec to Testament of Fortitude
